column1: # architecture/structure.tsv — the structure declaration (change package-structure-as-five-kinds, task 1.2).
# Columns, tab-separated, on every line below that does not start with #: module, package, kind, feature, may_import.
# kind is one of concept, port, feature, platform, shell. feature is the business name a feature or platform row carries, - when the package serves several or none.
# may_import is the permission the kind's rules give, not a census of the imports the code has today: - is "nothing of ours", "any" is shell only.

# Measured 2026-11-13: 332 main sources over 27 source packages — the sources: find app/src/main/java auto/src/main/java core/src/main/java -name '*.kt' | wc -l (332); the packages: the same find piped through sed 's#/[^/]*$##' | sort -u | wc -l (27).
# One row per package as the tree stands today, no file moved: a package the pilot or a later migration splits keeps its row until the files move.

# Added 2026-11-11 by change domain-vocabulary-is-declared: com.naviveylin.concept holds the skeleton types the glossary emits for a concept row no file declared, so the row set stays 1:1 with the tree.

# Added 2026-11-13 by change package-structure-as-five-kinds (task 7.1): com.naviveylin.core.port holds the pilot's port interfaces; the port files are new, no file moved, and every earlier row stands unchanged.
